dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: Well, I had a short stint in the Fortress of Meropide. Petty theft and such...

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: And when I came out, no one could recognize me any longer — they said I'd changed too much.

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: Well, I certainly was a leaner sight in the past — it took quite some effort just to move chairs, even. But unrecognizable, really? I just bulked up a little, that's all.
